payload.name: pc-check-retry-eligibility
payload.description: Deterministic pure-logic guard that decides whether a retry is eligible before any retry is considered. It is evidence-conditioned, not dispatch permission: it never grants Tool permission, does not replay completed effects, and does not bypass live policy. It returns true only when the outcome is retryable, the attempt count is below max_attempts, the operation state is not completed, and at least one durable idempotency condition holds (read_only or dedup_verified). It stops on missing, null or invalid typed inputs. It does not perform I/O, host calls or dispatch; the kernel still enforces current instance-wide Tool policy, technical constraints, cancellation, attempt freshness and resource limits before every actual dispatch and retry. The typed-runner interface (inputs mapping) is a target contract that still requires runner support. A timeout or lost response is unknown completion, not confirmed no effect, and must not be treated as safe to replay without trusted evidence or an explicit reconciliation path.
payload.content:
# Check retry eligibility before considering a retry.

operation_state = inputs["operation_state"]
outcome = inputs["outcome"]
attempt = inputs["attempt"]
max_attempts = inputs["max_attempts"]
read_only = inputs["read_only"]
dedup_verified = inputs["dedup_verified"]

if not isinstance(operation_state, str) or not isinstance(outcome, str):
    raise ValueError("operation_state and outcome must be strings")
if not isinstance(attempt, int) or isinstance(attempt, bool) or attempt <= 0:
    raise ValueError("attempt must be a positive integer")
if not isinstance(max_attempts, int) or isinstance(max_attempts, bool) or max_attempts <= 0:
    raise ValueError("max_attempts must be a positive integer")
if not isinstance(read_only, bool) or not isinstance(dedup_verified, bool):
    raise ValueError("read_only and dedup_verified must be booleans")

retry = (
    outcome == "retryable"
    and attempt < max_attempts
    and operation_state != "completed"
    and (read_only or dedup_verified)
)
result = {"retry": retry}
